nodes.statement: A RoCE peer with no accepted route triggers the route-mode unreachable classification.
The compared addresses have already passed link-layer and PKEY checks and both use RoCE.
uct_ib_iface_is_reachable_v2 enters RoCE reachability classification for the peer address.
The entry dispatches according to route, local_subnet, or all RoCE reachability mode.
Route classification obtains GID, address-family, netdev, and route information needed for the check.
The interface owns its configured reachability mode, GID prefix, and route-related state.
Route mode evaluates best-netdev, loopback, and kernel-local route candidates for the peer.
When none of the accepted route conditions hold, route mode classifies the peer unreachable.
The no-route branch fills an explanatory information string and returns false.
Reconfiguring to all mode bypasses version, family, GID conversion, subnet, and route checks after the outer envelope.
Replacing or closing the old interface releases the route-mode interface resources before the new configuration is used.
In all mode the same RoCE envelope is observed as reachable immediately, without proving transport connectivity.
The source oracle distinguishes route failure, local-subnet prefix behavior, and the all-mode short circuit.

edges.statement: The route-mode failure is evaluated only after confirming the common RoCE and PKEY envelope.
A matching RoCE envelope enters the interface reachability function.
The reachability entry dispatches to the classifier selected by the interface mode.
Route and local-subnet classifiers acquire the address and route state needed by their checks.
The acquired state is interpreted under the mode and prefix owned by the interface configuration.
Route mode uses the interface-owned configuration to evaluate accepted route candidates.
Failure of every accepted route condition yields an unreachable classification.
The unreachable branch records no-route information and returns false to the caller.
Changing the configured mode to all avoids the route branch that produced the false result.
Applying a new interface configuration replaces the prior route-mode interface state and releases its resources.
The all-mode interface returns reachable before consulting the route state used by the old mode.
The source oracle identifies the all-mode true result as a short circuit rather than route proof.

disconfirming_checks.statement: The all-mode true result assumes reachability and must not be treated as evidence of transport connectivity.
The existing local_subnet traffic test does not validate route mode or all-mode semantics.
